facts.claim: The server is the PyPI package mcp-server-git (latest 2026.10.10, uploaded 2026-10-11), run with uvx; --repository/-r selects the repository.
facts.evidence: README: uvx mcp-server-git; args ["mcp-server-git","--repository","path/to/git/repo"]; PyPI info.version 2026.10.10, not yanked.

facts.claim: Tools, all taking repo_path: git_status, git_diff_unstaged, git_diff_staged, git_diff, git_commit, git_add, git_reset, git_log, git_create_branch, git_checkout, git_show, git_branch.
facts.evidence: 12 tools listed; git_status needs only repo_path.

facts.claim: State-changing tools: git_commit, git_add, git_reset, git_create_branch, git_checkout. Read tools: git_status, git_diff*, git_log, git_show, git_branch.
Maintained in the modelcontextprotocol/servers repo (src/git), Beta classifier, README says early development; requires MCP Python SDK 1.x (mcp>=1.29.0,<2), v2 port in progress. Not archived.
facts.evidence: PyPI: Development Status :: 4 - Beta; README and GitHub index list Git as a current reference server.

facts.claim: --repository accepts any path inside a working tree and walks up to the repository root.
facts.evidence: accepts any path inside a Git working tree

choices.because: official server is a PyPI package run with uvx
